Absent for an external-registry counter (non-CC token whose instrumentAdmin is external): no deposit leg is built, the venue resume allocates the taker's own holdings via InitRequest_Execute instead.

legs.description: The prepared transactions this ceremony stashed, each with the id that describes it (GET /wallet/prepared/{legId}) and what it is for. Same set the three hashes above name, said once and without the caller having to know the key suffixes (CAN-1040).

submissionKey.description: submissionKey returned by the prepare step.

signature.description: Base64-encoded 64-byte Ed25519 signature of preparedTransactionHash (main accept leg). Omitted for EVM→Canton swaps, which have no accept-main leg.

initSignature.description: Base64-encoded 64-byte Ed25519 signature of initPreparedTransactionHash (counter init leg).

transferSignature.description: Base64-encoded 64-byte Ed25519 signature of transferPreparedTransactionHash (counter deposit leg). Omitted for an external-registry counter, which has no deposit leg to sign.

preimage.description: The preimage that hashes to the hashLock. Must be the same preimage used to claim the main HTLC.

preparedTransactions.description: Every prepared transaction of this ceremony, in the order they must be submitted. Present when one action needs more than one command — the participant refuses to prepare several at once, so a party funding two legs signs two hashes and posts both signatures back on the same commandId. The first entry is the same transaction the singular fields carry.

commands.description: Canton commands to execute (raw command objects)

signatures.description: Signatures for every prepared transaction of this ceremony, in the order prepare returned them. Send this instead of `signature` when prepare answered with more than one transaction; a short list submits only the transactions it covers.

serializedForSigning.description: Original serialized command hex (from prepareCommand) - used for signature verification

bridgeFee.description: What the bridge itself keeps, in the bridged instrument. Not always zero — a mainnet burn of 11 USDCx paid out 9 USDC. Null when there is nothing to base a number on.

netAmount.description: Expected amount on the destination; null when bridgeFee is unknown

bridgeFeeSource.description: protocol = structurally zero (mint calls depositToRemote with maxFee 0); observed = the fee the last settled transfer actually paid; unknown = nothing settled yet to learn from

bridgeFeeBasis.description: The transfer bridgeFee was measured on, when the source is observed. One observation is an absolute amount and we do not know whether the fee is flat or proportional, so the basis lets a client show what was measured rather than quote a fee for an unmeasured size.

estimatedGasFee.description: Always null — gas is recorded as actual only (never estimated)
